```yaml
name: autofix

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  autofix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js 24
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build all
        run: npm run all

      - name: Commit dist changes
        uses: autofix-ci/action@v1
        with:
          fail-fast: true
          commit-message: "chore: update dist"
          comment: "Auto-generated dist update"
```

name: autofix

  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  autofix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js 24
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build all
        run: npm run all

      - name: Commit dist changes
        uses: autofix-ci/action@v1
        with:
          fail-fast: true
          commit-message: "chore: update dist"
